{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
[[File:Dejarik_Falcon.png|thumb|280px|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] watching [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] playing dejarik aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]]]
{{Quote|No game of dejarik can be won without pawns&hellip;|[[Kreia]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>}}
'''Dejarik''' was a popular game which withstood the test of time better than nearly any other game in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It originated as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] game, though as it became much more widespread over time, many beings became unaware of its origins.

==Description==
[[File:Dejarik_table_btm.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A typical dejarik table]]
{{Quote|He made a fair move. Screaming about it won't help.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] scolding [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on his poor sportsmanship|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
Dejarik was played on a [[Hologame table/Legends|hologame table]], which comprised a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] generator within a table-sized cylindrical base, with a black-and-white checkerboard pattern on the top surface. When active, [[Holomonster/Legends|holomonsters]]&mdash;full-color, three-dimensional hologram playing pieces measuring between 5 and 30 cm tall&mdash;would be projected on the board. The pieces all resembled creatures, real and mythic, from throughout the galaxy, including the [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Mantellian Savrip]], [[Grimtaash/Legends|Grimtaash]] the [[Molator/Legends|Molator]], [[Ghhhk/Legends|Ghhhk]], [[Houjix/Legends|Houjix]], [[Ng'ok/Legends|Ng'ok]], [[Kintan strider/Legends|Kintan strider]], [[K'lor'slug/Legends|K'lor'slug]], and the [[M'onnok]]. These pieces, when moved by the player, acted out the moves as if really specimens of their species. If the pieces were not used for a certain amount of time or the game was abandoned by both players, they would simulate boredom.

Major dejarik tournaments included the [[Galactic Core Interzonals]].

The [[kintan strider death gambit]] was a notable tactic. Another was the fork and the K'lor'slug sacrifice, in the fork a player moved one holomonster to threaten at least two of the opponent's, and in the k'lor'slug sacrifice a k'lor'slug would destroy a piece to sacrifice itself. In the fork no matter what the opponent did one piece would be lost. It was considered a mistake in play to leave oneself vulnerable to a fork. The word fork came to be used as a generic term for facing a choice between two disasters: "We are well and truly forked."<ref name="Shatterpoint novel">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>

[[File:Let_the_Wookiee_Win_by_Francisco_Rico_Torres.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Chewbacca was a great player of dejarik, but he hated to lose.]]
The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] had a dejarik table in its lounge, installed at Chewbacca's urging.<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> It was around this table that preliminary peace talks between [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] were held.<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy, [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]] took a liking to the game, and had his [[Shaper caste|shapers]] create a version of the game with actual living pieces.

==Behind the scenes==
The game first appeared in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''A New Hope'' novelization]], where it is described but not named. Likewise, it is depicted but not named in the [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|corresponding film]]. The first name given to it was '''Space Chess''', in the instruction leaflet that came with [[Kenner Products]]'s 1979 [[W:c:swmerchandise:Millennium Falcon (39110)|''Millennium Falcon'' toy]]. It was named "dejarik" two decades later.
